<subject>Regulatory Affairs Budget for Years 2025/2026</subject>
<body>
Since Shirley and I are planning to be at Calgary tomorrow, we are providing you our laundry list of year end CAPEX items for discussion at your meeting tomorrow.

FYI, if we have more items than you need in total, the items I would prefer to pull back first would be the CRTC filing fees, the spectrum compliance costs, and the capitalization of network infrastructure overheads.

Please let us know how you wish to proceed.
</body>
